articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Looking At The Cisco Systems (CSCO) Narrative As Networking And AI Redefine The Story. Cisco Systems’ latest fair value estimate has edged to US$85.43 from US$85.24, with the discount rate assumption now 8.32% versus 8.26% previously and long term revenue growth essentially unchanged at about 5.87%. These fine tuned inputs reflect how recent research is weighing solid networking execution and growing artificial intelligence related orders against questions about security and the durability of the product mix.
